group.label: Order Filters
group.comment: Which new orders are reported (order.placed). Updates and credit memos follow the orders that were reported.

field.label: Orders to Send
field.comment: Default: orders with an affiliate code or any coupon code.

field.label: Coupon Prefixes
field.comment: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Example: ANA,MONTU. Only used by the "coupon starting with a configured prefix" mode.

field.label: Excluded Customer Groups
field.comment: Orders placed by these customer groups are never sent (for example wholesale or staff accounts).
